lead: Site navigation: the top level holds links or triggers with a drop-down panel. All panels share one popup, which moves and resizes smoothly when you switch between items. The root renders the popup automatically.

api.title: API Reference
api.description: The popup (portal + positioner + viewport) is rendered by `NavigationMenu` itself. `NavigationMenu.Trigger` comes with its own expand arrow; a `NavigationMenu.Link` in an `Item` is a top-level link, one in a `Content` a link in the panel.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles style these hooks in `navigation-menu.css`. As for every overlay, `data-skein-theme` must be set on `<html>`.
styling.navigation-menu: The wrapper, the list and the list items
styling.navigation-menu-trigger: The trigger, its expand arrow and the links
styling.navigation-menu-positioner: The shared popup and the content; its size transitions through `--popup-width` / `--popup-height`
